svg.aria-label: How I work, as seen in MatchPoint: 1. Start with what breaks: price variances, partial receipts, duplicate invoices. 2. Policy decides inside CFO authority before any ERP write. 3. Each write is idempotent and hash-chained in a tamper-evident log. 4. A post counts only once it is read back from the ERP.
